```{r}
library(data.table)
library(rtracklayer)

overlapSums <- function(x, y, z, na.rm=FALSE) {
  stopifnot(class(x)=="GRanges")
  stopifnot(class(y)=="GRanges")
  stopifnot(class(z)=="numeric" | class(z)=="integer")
  stopifnot(length(x)==length(z))
  ov <- as.matrix(findOverlaps(y, x))
  ovSums <- rep(as.numeric(NA), length(y))
  ovSums[unique(ov[,1])] <- viewSums(Views(z[ov[,2]], ranges(Rle(ov[,1]))), na.rm=na.rm)
  ovSums
}


overlapRatios <- function(x, y, C, cov, minCov, na.rm=FALSE) {
  C.sum <- overlapSums(x, y, values(x)[[C]], na.rm=na.rm)
  cov.sum <- overlapSums(x, y, values(x)[[cov]], na.rm=na.rm)
  ov_all <- as.data.frame(findOverlaps(y, x)) 
  number_of_CpGs <- rle(ov_all[,1])$lengths #--- total number of CpGs per region
  CpG_ov_regions <- x[ov_all$subjectHits] #--- coverage of CpGs overlapping regions
  ov_all$cov <- as.numeric(values(CpG_ov_regions)[[cov]])
  ov_all$cov_binary<-as.numeric(ifelse(ov_all$cov>=minCov, 1, 0))
  number_of_CpGs_minCov <- as.numeric(tapply(ov_all$cov_binary, ov_all$queryHits, FUN=sum))
  CpGs_covered <- as.numeric(number_of_CpGs_minCov) / as.numeric(number_of_CpGs)
  rat <- as.data.frame(C.sum/cov.sum)
  rat_cov<-cbind(rat, CpGs_covered)
  colnames(rat_cov) <- c("rat", "CpGs_covered")
  rat_cov$rat[rat_cov$CpGs_covered < 0.5] <- NA
  rat_cov[,1]
}


overlapRatios <- function(x, y, C, cov, minCov, na.rm=FALSE) {
  # Find overlaps
  ov_all <- as.data.frame(findOverlaps(y, x))
  result <- rep(NA, length(y))
  if(nrow(ov_all) == 0) return(result)
  ov_all$C <- values(x)[[C]][ov_all$subjectHits]
  ov_all$cov <- values(x)[[cov]][ov_all$subjectHits]
  ov_all$ratio <- ifelse(ov_all$cov >= minCov, 
                         ov_all$C / ov_all$cov, 
                         NA)
  n_total <- table(ov_all$queryHits)
  n_valid <- tapply(ov_all$cov >= minCov, ov_all$queryHits, sum)
  coverage_rate <- n_valid / n_total[names(n_valid)]
  mean_meth <- tapply(ov_all$ratio, ov_all$queryHits, 
                      function(x) mean(x, na.rm=TRUE))
  regions_with_data <- as.numeric(names(mean_meth))
  valid_regions <- regions_with_data[coverage_rate >= 0.5]
  result[valid_regions] <- mean_meth[as.character(valid_regions)]
  return(result)
}
```

```{r}
hypoE_hyperL <- import("/Users/ksenia/Documents/Lab_Garvan/projects/marsupials/EMseq_final_genome/DMCs_DMRcate/DMRs/dunnart_d9_vs_sperm.DMRs_hypo0.1.bed") #267686
```

```{r}
col<-seq(1, ncol(mcols(CpG)), by=2)
names <- sub("\\.(C|cov)$", "", colnames(mcols(CpG))[col])
col <- setNames(col, names)


hypoE_hyperL <- subsetByOverlaps(hypoE_hyperL, CpG)

av_meth <- mapply(function(a, b){overlapRatios(CpG, hypoE_hyperL, a, b, minCov=3)}, a = col, b = col+1) # calculates methylation ratio using .C and .cov of adjacent columns 
x<- as.data.frame(av_meth)

#chr5   94453164-94462960 - hypo both
mcols(hypoE_hyperL) <- cbind(mcols(hypoE_hyperL), x)

E9epi_hypo <- hypoE_hyperL[which(hypoE_hyperL$E9epi_r1 <= 0.1)]

hypoE_hyperL$delta_d9epi_sperm <- hypoE_hyperL$E9epi_r1  - (hypoE_hyperL$sperm_r1 + hypoE_hyperL$sperm_r2)/2
hypoE_hyperL$delta_d9te_sperm <- hypoE_hyperL$E9te_r1  - (hypoE_hyperL$sperm_r1 + hypoE_hyperL$sperm_r2)/2

hypoE_hyperL$E9epi_class <- ifelse(hypoE_hyperL$E9epi_r1 <= 0.2 & hypoE_hyperL$delta_d9epi_sperm < -0.3, "hypo", "not_hypo")
hypoE_hyperL$E9te_class <- ifelse(hypoE_hyperL$E9te_r1 <= 0.2 & hypoE_hyperL$delta_d9te_sperm < -0.3, "hypo", "not_hypo")

hypoE_hyperL$class <- paste0(hypoE_hyperL$E9epi_class, sep="_", hypoE_hyperL$E9te_class)
```

```{r}
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)

# Extract methylation data
meth_data <- as.data.frame(mcols(hypoE_hyperL)[, c("E9epi_r1", "E9te_r1", "sperm_r1", "sperm_r2")])

# Extract classification columns
E9epi_class <- mcols(hypoE_hyperL)$E9epi_class
E9te_class <- mcols(hypoE_hyperL)$E9te_class

# Create combined classification for grouping
combined_class <- paste(E9epi_class, E9te_class, sep="_")

# Calculate average methylation for each combined class
unique_classes <- unique(combined_class)
averaged_data <- matrix(nrow = length(unique_classes), ncol = ncol(meth_data))
colnames(averaged_data) <- colnames(meth_data)
rownames(averaged_data) <- unique_classes

# Calculate averages for each class combination
for(i in 1:length(unique_classes)) {
    class_idx <- which(combined_class == unique_classes[i])
    averaged_data[i, ] <- colMeans(meth_data[class_idx, ], na.rm = TRUE)
}

# Count number of regions in each class
class_counts <- table(combined_class)

# Create row labels with counts
row_labels_with_counts <- paste0(rownames(averaged_data), 
                                  " (n=", class_counts[rownames(averaged_data)], ")")

# Order the rows for better visualization
# Priority: hypo_hypo, hypo_not_hypo, not_hypo_hypo, not_hypo_not_hypo
row_order <- c(
    grep("^hypo_hypo$", rownames(averaged_data)),
    grep("^hypo_not_hypo$", rownames(averaged_data)),
    grep("^not_hypo_hypo$", rownames(averaged_data)),
    grep("^not_hypo_not_hypo$", rownames(averaged_data))
)
row_order <- row_order[row_order > 0]  # Remove any missing patterns

averaged_data_ordered <- averaged_data[row_order, ]
row_labels_ordered <- row_labels_with_counts[row_order]

# Create the heatmap
setwd("/Users/ksenia/Documents/Lab_Garvan/projects/marsupials/EMseq_final_genome/DMCs_DMRcate/DMRs/figures/")
pdf("hypoE_hyperL_methylation_by_class.pdf", width = 8, height = 6)
ht <- Heatmap(
    averaged_data_ordered,
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_columns = FALSE,

    col = colorRamp2(c(0, 0.5, 1), c("blue", "white", "red")),

    rect_gp = gpar(col = "white", lwd = 1),

    cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
        grid.text(sprintf("%.3f", averaged_data_ordered[i, j]), 
                  x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 10))
    },

    row_labels = row_labels_ordered,
    column_title = "Average Methylation by E9epi and E9te Classification",
    name = "Methylation",

    width = unit(10, "cm"),
    height = unit(length(row_order) * 1.5, "cm"),

    row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 11),
    column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 11),
    column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 14),

    heatmap_legend_param = list(
        title = "Methylation",
        at = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1),
        labels = c("0%", "25%", "50%", "75%", "100%"),
        legend_height = unit(4, "cm")
    )
)

draw(ht)
dev.off()

```

```{r}
go <- fread("/Users/ksenia/Documents/Lab_Garvan/projects/marsupials/EMseq_final_genome/DMCs_DMRcate/DMRs/hypo_EPI_genes/gprofiler_hypoE_hyperL_DMRs_E9epi_hypo_genebody_hypo_GENE_NAME_mouse.csv")

go_bp$term_name <- factor(go_bp$term_name, levels = go_bp$term_name[order(go_bp$negative_log10_of_adjusted_p_value)])

go_bp$term_size_div_domain_size <- go_bp$term_size / go_bp$effective_domain_size *100
go_bp$intersection_size_div_query_size <- go_bp$intersection_size / go_bp$query_size *100
go_bp$FoldEnrichment <- go_bp$intersection_size_div_query_size / go_bp$term_size_div_domain_size

library(dplyr)

# Add a column with asterisks for significant terms
go_bp <- go_bp %>%
  mutate(label = ifelse(adjusted_p_value < 0.05, "*", ""))

    labs(x = "GO Human Phenotype", y = "-log10(adjusted p-value)"))
```

###---expression of hypo genes in the mouse embryo
#https://tome.gs.washington.edu/
```{r}
e5.25 <- readRDS("/Users/ksenia/Documents/Lab_Garvan/projects/marsupials/Public/scRNAseq_mouse_TOME_WASHU/seurat_object_E5.25.rds")


library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)

# First, check if UMAP already exists
if("umap" %in% names(e5.25@reductions)) {
  # UMAP already computed, just plot it
  DimPlot(e5.25, reduction = "umap", pt.size = 1) + 
    ggtitle("e5.25 Mouse Embryo - UMAP")
} else {
  # Need to process the data first
  
  # 1. Normalize the data
  e5.25 <- NormalizeData(e5.25)
  
  # 2. Find variable features
  e5.25 <- FindVariableFeatures(e5.25, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
  
  # 3. Scale the data
  e5.25 <- ScaleData(e5.25)
  
  # 4. Run PCA
  e5.25 <- RunPCA(e5.25, features = VariableFeatures(object = e5.25))
  
  # 5. Find neighbors
  e5.25 <- FindNeighbors(e5.25, dims = 1:30)
  
  # 6. Find clusters
  e5.25 <- FindClusters(e5.25, resolution = 0.5)
  
  # 7. Run UMAP
  e5.25 <- RunUMAP(e5.25, dims = 1:30)
  
  # 8. Plot UMAP
  DimPlot(e5.25, reduction = "umap", pt.size = 1) + 
    ggtitle("e5.25 Mouse Embryo - UMAP")
}

setwd("/Users/ksenia/Documents/Lab_Garvan/projects/marsupials/invariant/final_T2T_genome/gene_bodies/Figures/")
pdf("dunnart_gene_bodies_retain_mC_E9te_expr_in_mouse_e5.25_UMAP.pdf", useDingbats=FALSE, width=5, height=5) 
print(DimPlot(e5.25, reduction = "umap", pt.size = 1) + 
    ggtitle("e5.25 Mouse Embryo - UMAP"))
dev.off()
```
